articles.title: Michael J. Fox emociona con su discurso en los Emmy 2026: "Aceptar el Parkinson no significaba que tuviera que rendirme"
articles.standfirst: El cinco veces ganador del Emmy fue reconocido en este caso por sus contribuciones a la defensa y la investigación de la enfermedad de Parkinson
articles.summary: El cinco veces ganador del Emmy fue reconocido en este caso por sus contribuciones a la defensa y la investigación de la enfermedad de Parkinson
articles.body: Michael J. Fox convive con su enfermedad, la del Parkinson, muchos años y cada vez que aparece es el fiel reflejo de la lucha y la ganas de estar. Lo ha vuelto a hacer en un escenario como el de los Premios Emmy 2026. El veterano actor recibió recibió el Premio Humanitario Bob Hope, un galardón que se ha entregado en seis ocasiones desde su creación, y dejó a todos con los sentimientos a flor de piel. Su discurso marcó esta gala. "Al principio, mantuve en secreto mi diagnóstico de Parkinson. Me preocupaba que afectara a mi trabajo y mi relación con el público. Me sorprendió el apoyo de todo el mundo, me sentí muy animado. Comprendí que aceptar la enfermedad no significaba que tuviera que rendirme. Tenía que hacer todo lo posible por todos los que viven con esto", manifestó el actor. Seguidamente añadió: "Me propuse abogar por la enfermedad de Parkinson y recaudar fondos. Encontré personas que lideraran esta iniciativa y me comprometí a financiar la mejor investigación científica del mundo. Estoy orgulloso del progreso que hemos logrado en beneficio de los pacientes y sus familias. Nos acercamos cada vez más a la erradicación definitiva de la enfermedad. Estoy profundamente agradecido a nuestro personal, donantes, investigadores y la comunidad de pacientes que hacen posible nuestro trabajo en la Fundación Michael J. Fox". La Fundación Michael J. Fox para la Investigación del Parkinson nació en el año 2000 poco después de hacer público su diagnóstico, que conoció en 1991 a los 29 años, a una edad extremadamente joven. Por ello, el cinco veces ganador del Emmy fue reconocido en este caso por sus contribuciones a la defensa y la investigación de la enfermedad de Parkinson.

articles.title: Márcio Victor chora ao descobrir indicação do Psirico ao Grammy Latino | G1
articles.standfirst: Grupo baiano concorre na categoria Melhor Álbum de Música de Raízes em Língua Portuguesa com ‘Molho Lambão’. Premiação acontece em novembro, em Las Vegas.
articles.summary: Grupo baiano concorre na categoria Melhor Álbum de Música de Raízes em Língua Portuguesa com ‘Molho Lambão’. Premiação acontece em novembro, em Las Vegas.
articles.body:
O cantor baiano Márcio Victor, vocalista do Psirico, chorou ao descobrir que o grupo baiano foi indicado ao Grammy Latino 2026. O cantor recebeu a notícia enquanto voltava dos Estados Unidos para Salvador , nesta quarta-feira (16), e comemorou ao telefone com a mãe e um amigo que estava na aeronave.

“Mainha, mainha. Cadê a senhora, mainha?”, diz Márcio Victor, emocionado, antes de revelar a novidade. “O Grammy! A gente foi indicado, Dudu!”, comemora.

Em seguida, o cantor celebra a realização do que considera um sonho antigo. “Eu sabia, véi, que a gente ia chegar um dia”, afirma.

Márcio Victor chora ao descobrir indicação do Psirico ao Grammy Latino 2026 — Foto: Reprodução/Redes Sociais

A reação chamou a atenção de um passageiro que estava sentado ao lado do artista. “Acabou de ser indicado ao Grammy?”, pergunta. Na sequência, ele parabeniza Márcio Victor.

O Psirico foi indicado na categoria Melhor Álbum de Música de Raízes em Língua Portuguesa pelo trabalho “Molho Lambão”. O grupo disputa o prêmio com Carminho, João Gomes, Mestrinho e Jota.pê, Juliana Linhares e Zaynara.

A indicação foi anunciada pela Academia Latina da Gravação nesta quarta-feira. A cerimônia da 27ª edição do Grammy Latino está marcada para 12 de novembro, em Las Vegas , nos Estados Unidos.

Além do Psirico, outros artistas baianos também aparecem entre os indicados ao Grammy Latino 2026.

A cantora Luedji Luna concorre na categoria Melhor Álbum de Pop Contemporâneo em Língua Portuguesa com “Antes Que A Terra Acabe”. Já Simone Mendes foi indicada a Melhor Álbum de Música Sertaneja com “Cantando Sua História 2 (Ao Vivo)”.

O cantor e compositor baiano Carlinhos Brown está entre os artistas ligados às indicações deste ano, apesar de não ter sido oficialmente indicado. Ele é um dos compositores de “Sua Onda”, de Marisa Monte, indicada na categoria Melhor Canção em Língua Portuguesa.

articles.title: Sridevi property dispute: Supreme Court issues notice to Boney Kapoor, Janhvi Kapoor and Khushi Kapoor over 2.70-acre land bought by the late actress in Chennai
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has issued notices to producer Boney Kapoor and his daughters, Janhvi Kapoor and Khushi Kapoor, in connection with a plea seeking to.
articles.body: The Supreme Court has issued notices to producer Boney Kapoor and his daughters, Janhvi Kapoor and Khushi Kapoor, in connection with a plea seeking to reopen a long-standing property dispute over land purchased by late actress Sridevi and her family in Chennai. The disputed property spans 2.70 acres.Supreme Court orders status quo, suggests mediationAccording to an IANS report, a bench comprising Justices K.V. Viswanathan and Arun Pillai took up a petition filed by M.C. Sivakami and her brother, M.C. Natarajan, who have staked a claim to a portion of the disputed property.The court directed both sides to maintain the status quo with regard to the property until the next hearing. It also suggested that the matter be resolved through mediation and proposed that a retired High Court judge oversee the process.The case has been scheduled for December 18, when the court will review the progress of the mediation.Background: Madras High Court’s April rulingThe Sivakami siblings approached the Supreme Court after the Madras High Court, on April 20, ruled in favour of the Kapoor family by allowing their revision petition and dismissing the civil suit filed by the siblings.The High Court concluded that the challenge to property transactions dating back to 1988 could not proceed as it was barred by limitation. It also held that the plaintiffs’ claims lacked sufficient legal basis based on the submissions before the court.What the land dispute involvesThe disputed property is located at Survey No. 1/1B in Sholinganallur, Chennai.According to details recorded by the Madras High Court, the petitioners identified themselves as the legal heirs of late M.C. Chandrasekaran and sought division of the property into five equal parts, claiming a one-fifth share for themselves.They also sought to invalidate sale deeds executed on April 19, 1988, in favour of Rajeshwari, Sreelatha and Sridevi, along with subsequent transactions relating to the property.Arguments before the Supreme CourtRepresenting the petitioners, their counsel argued that the High Court had examined complex questions, including whether the claimants were legitimate legal heirs and the validity of Chandrasekaran’s alleged second marriage, at a stage when the court was only required to determine whether the plaint should be rejected at the threshold.Representing the Kapoor family, senior advocate Abhishek Manu Singhvi pointed out that the original transaction took place in 1988, while the present suit was filed only in 2025.He further noted that the petitioners had attained adulthood in 1995 and 1999, respectively, and argued that the delay in filing the suit meant that the claim was beyond the permissible limitation period.The Supreme Court also sought clarity on whether Chandrasekaran held a one-fifth share in the property and whether there was any dispute regarding the petitioners being his biological children.Case’s legal historyThe dispute originated with a suit filed before the Additional District Judge in Chengalpattu. The trial court had initially refused to reject the plaint under Order VII Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure, holding that the contents of the plaint needed to be examined during the trial rather than at the preliminary stage.The Madras High Court subsequently reversed that decision on April 20, 2026.Justice T.V. Thamilselvi, presiding over a single-judge bench, held that the petitioners’ claim of having discovered the disputed transaction only in 2023 was not supported by the evidence on record. The court concluded that the challenge to the 1988 transactions was barred by limitation and ordered the plaint to be rejected.The High Court also noted that the same plaintiffs had filed an earlier suit in 2007 seeking a one-fifth share in family assets, which had been dismissed at the time.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: From Konkan to Karachi: Marathi tradition of Ganeshotsav celebrated across the border, too
articles.summary: Marathi-speaking families in Karachi celebrate Ganeshotsav with 700 devotees, a 5-ft handmade idol, daily aarti and a 5km procession to Ratneshwar temple.
articles.body: PUNE: Their ancestors moved from the Maratha heartland to the north during the Third Battle of Panipat circa 1761. Centuries later, after the Partition of 1947, the Marathi-speaking families of many of these travellers’ descendants remained settled in Pakistan. And, even today, they have managed to retain the connect to their Marathi roots. This year, nearly 700 Marathi-speaking Pakistani nationals are celebrating Ganeshotsav in the lanes of Karachi city amid much fanfare.On the first day of the festival, chants of “Ganapati Bappa Moraya” echoed as devotees took out a procession on a 5km stretch from Karachi’s Punjab Colony to Ratneshwar Mahadev temple. This year, the younger generation of Karachi’s Naik family, which has its roots in Maharashtra’s Konkan region, made a 5-ft tall Ganesh idol for the very first time.“We deliberately involved the youngsters in the idol-making process, so that they remain connected to our community’s religious traditions even while staying on this side of the border. From children to senior citizens, all members of our family participated in the activity. We are happy that we could install a 5-ft Lord Ganesha idol this year,” said Mukesh Naik, a member of the Marathi-speaking community of Karachi.The Naik family originally hails from Konkan, where Ganeshotsav has been feted in a traditional manner for centuries. Some members of their family moved to northern regions during the British rule in undivided India. After the Partition, they settled in Pakistan. For generations now, the Naiks have furthered the custom of celebrating Ganeshotsav with others in the community around them.Many such Marathi-speaking families connect with each other socially in Karachi under the umbrella of the Maharashtra Panchayat. Vishal Rajput, another such Marathi-speaking Pakistani national, told TOI on a call, “We want to keep our Marathi traditions alive while living in Pakistan. So, we celebrate every festival of ours — particularly Ganeshotsav — with much enthusiasm. Hundreds of community members here take part.”He added, “For the first time in our history, we are celebrating the festival for seven days at Karachi’s Ganesh Math Mandir. We conduct a daily aarti, distribute modaks and other Marathi traditional sweets as prasad, and will take out a procession with Lord Ganesha’s idol in the city.”Community members said they have expanded this festival’s celebrations in the last few years, including Sindhi and Punjabi-origin residents for the revelry. Organisers said it takes around one month to complete preparations ahead of the festivities.Vinod Daultram, another Marathi-speaking Karachi resident, told TOI, “Preparations begin with the beginning of the month of Shravan. While managing our daily work, we take out some time for idol-making, decorations and prasad preparations.”“This year’s 5ft-tall Ganesha idol was made in the span of a single month. Sculpting the face was the most difficult part. Since we did not have many references in Karachi, we took the help of social media and finally managed to bring out a beautiful idol,” Vinod added.Suman Naik, another Karachi resident, said preparing for this festival felt akin to serving the deity for her. “I painted the Ganesha idol for the first time, and I felt proud that I got the opportunity to connect with our religious tradition and serve god. articles.title: King Charles responds to Charles Spencer's claims about Princess Diana in a rare statement
articles.summary: King Charles broke royal protocol with a rare palace statement responding to Charles Spencer's explosive claims in his upcoming memoir, "Swan Song."
articles.body:
King Charles responds to claims made by Charles Spencer in his upcoming memoir about Princess Diana's funeral procession.

The 9th Earl of Spencer alleges that King Charles expressed contempt for Diana and her death, claiming that the world would soon forget her.

Buckingham Palace issued a statement on behalf of King Charles, acknowledging the pain of fraternal grief and emphasizing the potential impact on memory and judgment.

King Charles responded to claims made about him in Charles Spencer's upcoming book in an unusual move.

The Daily Mail published an excerpt of Spencer's upcoming memoir, "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister," Wednesday, in which the king's former brother-in-law alleged a heated conversation he had with Charles after the death of his sister and the former Princess of Wales, Princess Diana.

"Prince Charles continued his stream of anger, without me interrupting. Then he stopped. I assumed the pause signaled an effort to bring himself under control, but then he unleashed down the phone what I have always taken to be his pent-up contempt for Diana, and his horror that the world was so bowled over by her death," Spencer alleged, according to the Daily Mail. "'Rest assured,' he hissed, 'we'll forget her soon enough!'"

According to the excerpt, the disagreement between King Charles and the 9th Earl of Spencer was regarding the decision to have Prince William and Prince Harry, then 15 and 12, walk behind their mother's casket during the funeral procession.

A Buckingham Palace spokesperson issued a rare statement on behalf of the king responding to Spencer's claims.

"While we do not comment on books as a matter of principle, His Majesty is mindful that the pain of fraternal grief can cloud reason, affect judgment and color memory in ways others do not recognize, even many years after such a loss," the statement said, according to People .

Princess Diana died in August 1997 at age 36 after suffering injuries sustained in a car accident in the Pont de l'Alma tunnel in Paris, France. Her partner, Dodi Fayed, and the driver, Henri Paul, also died in the crash.

At the time of her death, she and King Charles had been divorced for one year. The two married in July 1981, announced their separation in December 1992 and finalized their divorce in August 1996.

Prince Harry wrote about the decision to have him and his brother walk behind their mother's coffin in his 2023 memoir, "Spare," writing that "several adults were aghast" and that "mummy's brother, Uncle Charles, raised hell," and that he told the royal family, "You can't make these boys walk behind their mother's coffin! It's barbaric."

This is not the first time Spencer has spoken about his opposition to the boys walking behind their mother's coffin. He told BBC Radio 4's Today in 2017 that he found the decision "bizarre and cruel."

"It was the most horrifying half an hour of my life," he said. "It was just ghastly. And it was far worse than having to deliver a speech at the end of it. It was the worst part of the day by a considerable margin, walking behind, well, my sister's body, with two boys who were obviously massively grieving their mother.

"And it was this sort of bizarre circumstance where we were told you had to look straight ahead," he continued. "But the feeling, the sort of crashing tidal wave of grief coming at you as you went down this sort of tunnel of deep emotion, it was really harrowing actually, and I still have nightmares about it now."

" Swan Song: Diana, My Sister " is set to be released Sept. 22.

articles.title: Gaby Amarantos, aclamada pelo álbum 'Rock doido', é ausência sentida entre os indicados ao Grammy Latino 2026 | G1
articles.body:
Gaby Amarantos é injustiçada pelos membros votantes do Grammy Latino 2026 — Foto: Divulgação

♬ Desde que a Academia Latina da Gravação divulgou à lista de indicados à 27ª edição do Grammy Latino na manhã de ontem, 16 de setembro, um nome circulou na mídia e nas rede sociais – não pela presença na relação de artistas brasileiros nomeados nas diversas categorias da premiação agendada para 12 de novembro, em Las Vegas (EUA), mas justamente pela ausência.

Não, Gaby Amarantos não foi indicada ao Grammy Latino 2026 em ação (ou falta de) que gerou estranhamento, surpresa e até indignação. Afinal, a cantora e compositora paraense lançou em 29 de agosto do ano passado um álbum, “Rock doido” (2025), aclamado por toda a crítica e pelo público.

“Rock doido” foi título recorrente nas listas de melhores discos de 2025 e gerou show igualmente aplaudido. Desde o primeiro álbum solo, “Treme”, lançado em 2012, Amarantos não era tão incensada em todo o universo pop brasileiro.

Álbum vibrante, estruturado como se fosse um set de DJ numa aparelhagem, nome das festas realizadas em Belém (PA) no circuito do tecnobrega, “Rock doido” foi rara unanimidade entre críticos de todas as tribos.

Por isso mesmo, provocou questionamentos o fato de o álbum não ter gerado sequer uma indicação para Gaby Amarantos em qualquer uma das categorias dedicadas pelo Grammy Latino à produção fonográfica brasileira do período que foi de 1º de junho de 2025 a 31 de maio de 2026.

Afinal, “Rock doido” foi eleito o “Álbum do ano” nas premiações da APCA (Associação Paulista de Críticos de Arte) e do WNE Awards 2025. Sem falar que o álbum faturou o troféu de melhor produto audiovisual na edição de 2026 do Prêmio da Música Brasileira. Ou seja, somente o Grammy Latino 2026 esnobou o festivo disco de Gaby Amarantos.

Talvez os membros votantes tenham se espantado com o tom desbocado de algumas letras ou talvez não tenham entendido o conceito do álbum. Ou então simplesmente minimizaram a importância de “Rock doido” na discografia brasileira recente. É uma pena...

Ainda que o álbum de Gaby Amarantos já esteja mais do que validado pelos críticos, pelo público e por outras premiações, pairou no ar uma sensação de injustiça com a artista.

articles.title: Presidente do Água Santa é alvo de operação contra PCC no transporte | G1
articles.standfirst: Paulo Sirqueira Korek Farias, o 'Paulo Camarão', é apontado como empresário do setor de transportes e 'testa de ferro' da organização criminosa. Ele ainda não foi preso.
articles.summary: Paulo Sirqueira Korek Farias, o 'Paulo Camarão', é apontado como empresário do setor de transportes e suposto 'testa de ferro' da organização criminosa. Ele não foi preso.
articles.body:
Paulo Sirqueira Korek Farias, conhecido como Paulo Camarão, presidente do Esporte Clube Água Santa, é um dos alvos dos mandados de prisões na operação desta quinta-feira (17) feita pelo Ministério Público (MP) e pela Polícia Civil de São Paulo para investigar a infiltração do Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) no sistema de transporte coletivo da capital.

Segundo a investigação, Paulo Camarão é empresário do setor de transportes, gestor das empresas Translíder e A2 Transportes e apontado como suposto "testa de ferro" da organização criminosa. Há um mandado de prisão temporária contra ele, que ainda não foi preso. A equipe de reportagem tenta contato com a sua defesa.

O nome de Paulo Sirqueira Korek Farias consta como presidente do Água Santa no cadastro da Federação Paulista de Futebol (FPF). O clube é da cidade de Diadema, na Grande São Paulo. Ele foi fundado em 1981 e profissionalizado em 2011.

'Paulo Camarão', um dos alvos da operação do MP, é presidente do Água Santa, time de futebol vice-campeão paulista de 2023. — Foto: Reprodução/Arquivo pessoal

Sob a gestão de Paulo Camarão, o Água Santa viveu em 2023 o momento de maior destaque de sua história no futebol profissional.

O clube chegou à final do Campeonato Paulista da Primeira Divisão, a elite do futebol estadual, e terminou como vice-campeão . A equipe de Diadema venceu o Palmeiras por 2 a 1 no jogo de ida da decisão, mas perdeu por 4 a 0 na partida de volta. O Palmeiras ficou com o título.

A campanha foi histórica para o Água Santa, que eliminou São Paulo e Red Bull Bragantino antes de chegar à final.

Em 2015, o Água Santa chegou pela primeira vez à elite do Campeonato Paulista. Atualmente, o Água Santa está na Série A2 do Campeonato Paulista, a Segunda Divisão do futebol estadual, depois de ter sido rebaixado em 2025.

Operação investiga infiltração no transporte

Paulo Farias, o 'Paulo Camarão', é presidente do Água Santa, segundo site da Federação Paulista de Futebol. — Foto: Reprodução/FPF

A operação desta quinta-feira investiga a atuação do PCC no setor de transporte coletivo de São Paulo. Segundo o Ministério Público, foram identificadas pelo menos 12 empresas de transporte de passageiros que seriam controladas direta ou indiretamente pela facção.

Entre os alvos está o ex-presidente da Câmara Municipal de São Paulo Milton Leite, que teve a prisão temporária autorizada pela Justiça. Ao todo, a operação cumpre 16 mandados de prisão e 18 de busca e apreensão.

A investigação apura suspeitas relacionadas à atuação do crime organizado no sistema de transporte e à possível participação de pessoas ligadas ao setor empresarial e à política.

articles.title: Stray Kids fala ao g1: a entrevista completa do grupo de K-Pop no camarim do Rock in Rio | G1
articles.standfirst: Bang Chan, Lee Know, Changbin, Hyunjin, Han, Felix, Seungmin e I.N falaram sobre fãs, música brasileira, lightsticks, setlist, futebol e colaborações internacionais.
articles.summary: Bang Chan, Lee Know, Changbin, Hyunjin, Han, Felix, Seungmin e I.N falaram sobre fãs, música brasileira, lightsticks, setlist, futebol e colaborações internacionais.
articles.body:
Em sua segunda vinda ao Brasil, após passagens por grandes estádios no ano anterior, o Stray Kids encerrou a programação do quinto dia de Rock in Rio com uma megaestrutura, um som deliciosamente caótico e coreografias precisas. Eram oito integrantes no palco, mas a verdadeira força da noite veio da plateia que transformou a Cidade do Rock em Cidade do K-Pop.

Em entrevista ao g1 , os oito integrantes da banda sul-coreana falaram de seu processo criativo, da paixão pelo funk carioca e pelo futebol... e, claro, de seu fandom. "Com seus lightsticks, nossos fãs parecem nos guiar para encontrarmos o caminho certo", garantiu Seungmin.

Veja abaixo e no vídeo do topo, a entrevista completa com o Stray Kids.

G1 - Vocês são os headliners do primeiro dia dedicado ao K-pop no Rock in Rio, então qual é a sensação de fazer história dessa forma?

Felix (Stray Kids) - Nós achamos que escrever nossa própria história é algo que consideramos com muita gratidão e orgulho. Nós nos preparamos muito para que este festival seja divertido para os fãs, e agradecemos aos Stay por nos permitirem estar em um palco tão grande.

G1 - Os fãs brasileiros são famosos por serem muito barulhentos. É... como esse nível de intensidade pode afetar a apresentação de vocês no palco?

Felix (Stray Kids) - Nós já viemos antes e foi muito divertido. Estar em um festival grande de rock e pop no Brasil novamente é motivo de muito orgulho, somos muito gratos aos fãs e faremos uma apresentação inesquecível.

G1 - Existe algum artista, música ou estilo musical brasileiro que já chamou a atenção de vocês, que está na playlist de vocês?

Felix (Stray Kids) - Estes dias eu tenho ouvido muito baile funk, e também muito do… Jamal... você conhece a dança do Jamal [passinho do Jamal]? Então, eu tenho ouvido bastante esse gênero, que está forte se comparado a outros estilos de dança. É muito moderno e acho muito divertido de ouvir.

Stray Kids no Palco Mundo do Rock in Rio 2026 — Foto: Leo Franco/AgNews

G1 - Os lightsticks costumam ser proibidos em festivais aqui, mas a organização do Rock in Rio abriu uma exceção por causa de vocês. Qual a importância disso pra ter uma experiência completa num show de k-pop?

Seungmin (Stray Kids) - Na verdade, não é apenas mostrar o apoio, mas sentir esse apoio junto durante a participação nas apresentações tem uma importância imensa. O nome do nosso grupo é Stray Kids, e às vezes nos “perdemos” no palco, mas as Stays, que são o nosso fandom, com seus lightsticks, parecem nos guiar para encontrarmos o caminho certo. É muito significativo receber essa luz e esse carinho.

G1 - Um festival é diferente de uma apresentação de turnê, ainda mais porque o festival tem os novos ouvintes que tão meio caindo de paraquedas... Como vocês montam o setlist para um evento maior que não tem só fãs, tem também curiosos?

Han (Stray Kids) - Nessas situações, nós escolhemos as músicas em que temos mais confiança e que melhor demonstram a nossa essência e o nosso estilo. Mesmo para quem não nos conhece, queremos tocar músicas que façam as pessoas quererem cantar junto e mostrar o nosso cem por cento de energia. É uma oportunidade para que novos públicos descubram quem somos.

G1 - Quando vocês trabalham com produtores ocidentais, como é o processo criativo e como misturar estilos (que é algo normal no K-pop) sem perder a identidade de vocês?

Bang Chan (Stray Kids) - Bem, nós somos muito abertos. Estamos dispostos a colaborar e trabalhar com muitos artistas diferentes. A maior parte do tempo, tentamos ouvir o que os outros artistas ou colaboradores querem fazer, e então encontramos um meio-termo para trabalhar juntos e misturar os nossos estilos. Então sim, é sempre muito divertido, podemos criar novos projetos e abrir a grande variedade da nossa música. Muito obrigado!

G1 - Tem alguma comida brasileira, ponto turístico ou algo da cultura brasileira que vocês estão animados pra experimentar enquanto estiverem no Brasil?

I.N. (Stray Kids) - No ano passado, quando viemos, fomos à praia e conhecemos algumas pessoas jogando futebol, e acabamos jogando com elas. Foi uma experiência muito divertida. Se houver oportunidade, gostaríamos muito de jogar futebol novamente com os fãs e com as pessoas locais aqui no Brasil.

G1 - Os fãs brasileiros esperaram muito por esse momento, de ter uma noite de k-pop no Rock in Rio. Sempre pediram. Qual a mensagem que vocês têm para todo mundo que fez esse show acontecer por meio de manifestações nas redes e tal?

Changbin (Stray Kids) - Nós agradecemos de coração por terem nos esperado tanto tempo. Nós também esperamos muito por este momento e fizemos o nosso melhor para preparar um show incrível. Vamos continuar nos esforçando para entregar o nosso melhor e retribuir todo esse carinho dos fãs brasileiros. Obrigado!

articles.summary: Conheça a história da música que era uma mistura de várias faixas e se tornou o hit do Carnaval em 2025.
articles.body:
Em 2025, na era do TikTok e dos conteúdos rápidos, ninguém esperava que uma música de 6 minutos ficasse na boca do povo brasileiro. Isso até a gente conhecer J. Eskine.

Esta matéria faz parte da série "20 hits em 20 anos", que está no GloboPop, o novo aplicativo de vídeos curtos verticais da Globo, disponível gratuitamente no seu celular. Lá no app, você pode seguir o palco do "20 hits em 20 anos" para não perder nenhum episódio. Baixe o GloboPop aqui !

O cantor baiano começou cantando trap, mas foi no arrocha que ele se encontrou, seguindo um caminho curioso com releituras do pagodão baiano.

É o caso de "Resenha do Arrocha", lançada no fim de 2024. A letra passa por assuntos como Jogo do Tigrinho, passinho do Romano e depilação, e parece ser várias músicas em uma... porque é exatamente isso.

J. Esquine no clipe de 'Resenha do Arrocha' — Foto: Reprodução

"Resenha do Arrocha" é um medley, ou seja, une trechos de outras músicas pré-existentes. Não foi J. Eskine quem inventou esse formato, que é bem comum na música brasileira... mas o jeito que ele fez deu liga.

Isso porque a maior parte das faixas citadas é, originalmente, um pagodão baiano. Ali, elas são unidas em uma base de arrocha, com o timbre marcante de J. Eskine. Cada virada da música te pega de surpresa.

J. Eskine conta que foi tudo no freestyle. E dá para ver que ele está se divertindo ao cantar e chega até a rir, o que faz a gente rir também.

Claro que o timing ajudou muito: a música saiu a tempo do Carnaval. Nos blocos, uma música de 6 minutos tocava do início ao fim com todo mundo sabendo a letra, ou pelo menos uma parte dela. "Resenha do Arrocha" foi o hit de 2025 que desafiou a lógica das redes.

articles.title: In 2008, Leonardo DiCaprio bought a $3.67 million Manhattan apartment inside a building powered by solar panels; what made the Riverhouse different
articles.summary: Explore Leonardo DiCaprio's purchase of a sustainable $3.67 million apartment in Battery Park City's Riverhouse, showcasing luxury living with solar energy and innovative green features.
articles.body: In 2008, Leonardo DiCaprio added a Manhattan apartment to his property portfolio, but the building he chose stood apart from many luxury residences in New York. Located in Battery Park City, Riverhouse was designed around environmentally conscious features, including solar panels, filtered air and a water-treatment system. For an actor who had already become closely associated with environmental causes, the address was a natural fit.At the time, CBS News reported that DiCaprio had purchased an apartment in the 264-unit Riverhouse development, which overlooks the Hudson River and a nearby park. The building was promoted for its focus on reducing its environmental impact while offering the amenities expected from a high-end condominium.A home inside one of Manhattan's early green residential buildingsRiverhouse was completed in 2008 and received LEED Gold certification, according to the Battery Park City Authority. The project was developed by the Sheldrake Organisation, with architecture by Polshek Partnership in collaboration with Ismael Leyva Architects and design work by David Rockwell.Its environmental features were part of the building's design from the beginning. CBS News reported that Riverhouse had low-emission paints, a 24-hour fresh filtered-air system, a water-treatment facility and solar panels that could rotate to follow the sun.The building's approach went beyond simply putting solar panels on the roof. A case study from the Urban Green Council also documents features such as tracking photovoltaic panels, blackwater and rainwater treatment systems, triple-glazed curtain-wall windows and a combined heat-and-power system.How much did Leonardo DiCaprio pay for the apartment?The amount was not disclosed by DiCaprio's representative when the purchase was first reported in April 2008. CBS News confirmed the acquisition but did not publish a purchase price at the time.CityRealty later reported that DiCaprio paid $3.67 million for his first Riverhouse apartment. The actor eventually expanded his presence in the building by purchasing the neighbouring unit in 2014 for $8 million.That second purchase gave him an even larger footprint in the Battery Park City development. CityRealty reported that the neighbouring apartment measured about 2,327 square feet and included approximately 1,035 square feet of outdoor space.The building was designed around cleaner indoor spacesOne of Riverhouse's unusual selling points was its approach to indoor air quality. Rather than relying on ordinary ventilation alone, the building incorporated a filtration system designed to provide residents with fresh, filtered air. CityRealty also reported that the building used water filters, humidity control and low-pollution materials as part of its environmentally focused design.The emphasis on air and water was paired with materials selected with sustainability in mind. The Urban Green Council's case study notes the project's attention to indoor environmental quality and water treatment, showing that these systems were integrated into the development rather than added simply as luxury extras.Solar panels were part of the building's identityThe solar technology was another feature that distinguished Riverhouse when it opened. Reports described the building's solar panels as rotating panels, while the Urban Green Council identified them as tracking photovoltaic panels. Their ability to follow the sun was part of Riverhouse's broader effort to incorporate renewable energy into a high-rise residential project.The building's green credentials were therefore tied to several systems working together: renewable energy, water treatment, air filtration and materials chosen with environmental considerations in mind.A luxury building with plenty beyond its green featuresSustainability did not mean Riverhouse lacked the amenities associated with Manhattan luxury living.The development included a 50-foot lap pool, fitness facilities, a landscaped terrace, media café and dog spa, according to the report. The building also had spaces such as a yoga studio and billiards room.Its waterfront location added another attraction. Riverhouse sits at 2 River Terrace in Battery Park City, overlooking the Hudson River and Rockefeller Park. The Battery Park City Authority lists the building as part of the neighbourhood's North Neighbourhood and confirms its 2008 completion and LEED Gold certification.Leonardo DiCaprio later bought the apartment next doorSix years after his first purchase, DiCaprio returned to Riverhouse. In 2014, he acquired the neighbouring apartment for $8 million, according to CityRealty. The purchase effectively expanded his space within the same environmentally focused development rather than moving to another Manhattan building.The choice also fits a pattern in DiCaprio's real-estate portfolio. Architectural Digest has noted his interest in environmentally conscious properties, including his Battery Park City apartments and his plans for the sustainable Blackadore Caye project in Belize.What made the Riverhouse purchase notable was not simply the celebrity attached to it. In 2008, DiCaprio chose a residence in a building where renewable energy, air filtration and water treatment were built into the development itself. More than a luxury Manhattan address, Riverhouse offered an early example of how sustainability could be incorporated into high-end urban living.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Netanyahu threatens to revoke Israeli citizenship of NAZA filmmakers
articles.summary: Israeli prime minister pledges to advance two bills aimed at addressing the ‘immense damage’ done to Israeli soldiers.
articles.body:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has pledged to pass a law that would revoke the citizenship of anyone who defames ⁠Israel’s soldiers, including the directors of NAZA, a documentary about Israeli soldiers’ killings of civilians in Gaza.

Directed by Israeli journalists Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, NAZA documents allegations that mass civilian deaths were built into Israel’s target decisions in its genocidal war against Palestinians in Gaza – something Netanyahu and the army reject.

The film won the Special Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival last week. During his acceptance speech, Abraham said “our country is doing these crimes” and highlighted that Israel is systematically and deliberately targeting Palestinians in Gaza.

“NAZA” takes its title from an Israeli ⁠military term for expected “collateral casualties” and is built around anonymous interviews with intelligence officers and soldiers.

It has been harshly criticised in Israel, with the military examining potential legal action against those involved in it .

But it has also played into the charged domestic political atmosphere before Israel’s October 27 election , as public opinion polls suggest Netanyahu’s ‌right-wing coalition could fall short of a majority in parliament.

On Tuesday, Netanyahu accused several of his election rivals of failing to take a tough stand against the documentary, claiming this made them unfit for office.

On Wednesday, he pledged to advance two bills that he said would address the “immense damage” done to Israeli soldiers in the film.

“The first [order]: To revoke the citizenship of anyone who defames [Israeli] soldiers, and the second: To hit them in their pockets and increase the statutory damages for defamation they can ⁠be sued for by 20 times,” Netanyahu said in a social media video. “We ⁠will hit them both in their pockets and in their citizenship, as their place is not with us.”

Netanyahu cited three examples in proposing the bills: “The recent film NAZA which portrayed [Israeli] officers and soldiers as war criminals”, 2025 remarks by left-wing ex-general-⁠turned-politician Yair Golan that “a sane country does not kill children as a hobby”, and a military legal officer’s 2024 leak of a video showing ⁠soldiers abusing a Gaza detainee.

In 2022, Israel’s Supreme Court passed a law that permits stripping citizenship from Israelis who carry out actions that constitute a breach of trust against the state. Any new legislation would likely face similar court challenges.

More than 73,000 Palestinians, most of them civilians, have been killed in Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza since October 2023, according to health authorities.

articles.title: MTV and NBC childhood star handed federal prison sentence
articles.summary: The "Role Models" and "30 Rock" star pleaded guilty to illegally possessing a firearm, the latest in a series of legal troubles.
articles.body:
Bobb'e Thompson, the actor who appeared on NBC's 30 Rock and MTV's Wild 'N Out , has been sentenced to 30 months in federal prison after pleading guilty to illegally possessing a firearm.

Thompson, 30, was arrested in September 2025 after Iowa law enforcement stopped the vehicle he was driving for speeding and found a loaded .40-caliber handgun inside that had been reported stolen from Kansas City, Missouri.

The vehicle was traveling 104 mph in a 70 mph zone and contained several bags of marijuana along with the handgun, prosecutors said.

Thompson is known for playing Tracy Jr. on 30 Rock , the trickster Stanley on That's So Raven, Ronnie Shields on Role Models and Jimmy Mitchell on The Tracy Morgan Show .

Along with the prison sentence, Thompson must serve a three-year term of supervised release, as ordered by U.S. District Court Judge Leonard T. Strand in Sioux City.

The actor is being held in the custody of the U.S. Marshals Service until he can be transported to a federal prison.

The U.S. Attorney's Office for the Northern District of Iowa noted in a news release that Thompson has a prior criminal record that includes convictions for battery, assault and illegal firearm possession.

Newsweek contacted Thompson's attorney via email on Thursday outside regular working hours.

Thompson's arrest last September came after law enforcement in Cerro Gordo County stopped his vehicle for speeding.

An officer said he observed Thompson and the passenger switching seats, which Thompson later disputed. However, prosecutors said in court documents that the officer reported the female passenger said she switched seats because she was "trying to be a good spouse."

As the officer approached the vehicle, he noticed an odor of marijuana, according to prosecutors. During a search of the vehicle, the marijuana and firearm were discovered in a backpack belonging to Thompson.

Thompson pleaded guilty to possession of a firearm by a prohibited person at a hearing in April.

Court documents show that he had previously been convicted of battery with serious bodily injury and assault with force in 2020, as well as prohibited possession of a firearm in 2022.

His attorneys argued ahead of the recent sentencing that the 2020 battery conviction should not be treated as a "crime of violence" under federal sentencing guidelines, which could have increased his recommended sentence.

The guideline sentencing range was 18 to 24 months, with a maximum possible sentence of 15 years. Thompson was ultimately sentenced to 30 months in federal prison.

Thompson Previously Reflected on 'Dumb' Legal Troubles

Thompson previously discussed his legal issues and described getting into trouble over "dumb" things in a 2024 appearance on the Eating While Broke podcast.

The former child actor said he "started catching cases and lawyer fees and bond money."

"I caught a gun case," Thompson said on the podcast. "And then before that, I caught a case. I got in a fistfight and broke the boy jaw. And because of the jaw being broken, it was a great bodily injury, and it became a felony."

He also discussed how mismanaging his finances meant he couldn't afford to hire a lawyer, adding that he "went on the run for six months" before returning to Los Angeles and being "locked up."

articles.title: Motivational quote of the day by Zendaya: ‘Don't try so hard to fit in, and certainly don't try so hard to be different; just try hard to be you.' The Odyssey star's words of wisdom on why you need to stay true to yourself
articles.summary: Discover Zendaya's inspirational quote on authenticity and individuality. Learn about her journey from child performer to Hollywood star and the importance of staying true to oneself.
articles.body: Zendaya has emerged as an inspirational figure for audiences around the world. From beginning her career as a child performer to becoming one of Hollywood’s most sought-after actors, she has built a successful career while carving out her own identity. Her journey also reflects the importance of staying committed to yourself and your ambitions despite the pressures and expectations that come with fame.The motivational quote of the day by Zendaya reads: “Don't try so hard to fit in, and certainly don't try so hard to be different; just try hard to be you.”What does the quote mean?Zendaya shared these words in her 2013 advice book, Between U and Me: How to Rock Your Tween Years with Style and Confidence. The quote reflects her broader message about resisting the pressure to behave according to society’s expectations and instead developing a stronger understanding of who you are.Rather than constantly changing yourself to gain approval or meet other people’s expectations, the quote encourages people to focus on becoming comfortable with their own identity. Trying too hard to fit in can mean suppressing your opinions, interests or personality, while deliberately trying to stand out can be just another way of allowing other people to dictate your choices.At its core, the message is about authenticity. There is little value in changing who you are simply to blend into a particular group or prove that you are different from everyone else. Staying connected to your values, strengths and individuality can help you make choices that feel more genuine in the long run.Being yourself, however, does not necessarily mean remaining passive. It can require self-awareness, confidence and continuous effort. Zendaya’s words encourage people to direct that energy towards developing their own abilities and character instead of constantly worrying about how they are perceived by others.About Zendaya’s lifeZendaya Maree Stoermer Coleman was born on September 1, 1996, in Oakland, California. She grew up in an arts-focused household, with her parents, Claire Stoermer and Kazembe Ajamu Coleman, supporting her ambitions. Both of her parents worked as teachers. Zendaya was introduced to acting and theatre through the California Shakespeare Theater in Orinda, California, where her mother worked as a house manager during the summer. Spending time around the theatre and observing performances helped spark her interest in acting.Alongside acting, Zendaya developed her skills as a dancer. She spent three years performing with Future Shock Oakland, a hip-hop dance troupe, and also studied classical theatre at the American Conservatory Theater in San Francisco. She subsequently appeared in commercials and worked as a backup dancer for performers including Selena Gomez. Her major breakthrough came in 2009 when she was cast as Rocky Blue in the Disney Channel series Shake It Up. The role brought her widespread recognition and marked the beginning of her rise to stardom.After establishing herself on television, Zendaya made her feature-film debut in 2017 with Marvel’s 'Spider-Man: Homecoming'. She played Michelle “MJ” Jones opposite Tom Holland, who portrayed Peter Parker. The film became a major milestone in her career, and she subsequently reprised the role in Spider-Man: Far From Home and Spider-Man: No Way Home. Her performances in projects such as The Greatest Showman, Malcolm & Marie, Dune and Dune: Part Two further established her as a versatile performer. Her work on the HBO series 'Euphoria' also earned widespread critical recognition, with Zendaya winning two Primetime Emmy Awards for her portrayal of Rue Bennett.Zendaya and Tom Holland’s relationshipZendaya and Tom Holland have maintained a notably private relationship despite years of public interest in their personal lives. The pair initially denied dating rumours after meeting while working on the Spider-Man films. In 2021, photographs of the two kissing in Los Angeles appeared online, leading to widespread speculation about their relationship. They have since occasionally spoken about their bond while generally keeping their personal lives away from the spotlight. Their relationship has continued alongside their professional collaborations, with both actors maintaining a relatively private approach to their lives away from their work.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Carlos Bardem: "Con Guy Ritchie, yo no rodé nunca una frase que estuviera en el guion"
articles.standfirst: El actor presenta 'En la zona gris', un thriller lleno de acción dirigido por Guy Ritchie
articles.summary: El actor presenta 'En la zona gris', un thriller lleno de acción dirigido por Guy Ritchie
articles.body: Carlos Bardem protagoniza 'En la zona gris', la nueva película de Guy Ritchie, un thriller de acción en el que interpreta a Manny Salazar, un multimillonario que se convierte en el objetivo de un grupo de criminales que pretende arrebatarle mil millones de dólares. La cinta, rodada en 2023, cuenta con un reparto internacional encabezado por Jake Gyllenhaal, Henry Cavill, Eiza González y Rosamund Pike y combina acción, humor y los diálogos característicos del cine de Ritchie. La película llega ahora a España después de varios retrasos en su distribución. Con motivo de su estreno, hablamos con Carlos Bardem sobre su experiencia trabajando con Guy Ritchie y sobre el particular método del director británico, pero también sobre su nueva novela, 'Triángulo', la violencia verbal, su compromiso con distintas causas sociales y su relación con el Atlético de Madrid y el fútbol moderno. En 'En la zona gris' interpretas a Manny Salazar, un multimillonario al que quieren arrebatar mil millones de dólares. ¿Qué te atrajo de él? Lo primero que considero siempre es el guion. Lo leí y me pareció muy divertido, una película de Guy Ritchie, con acción y diálogos llenos de humor. Además, estaba la posibilidad de trabajar con Ritchie y con un casting como el de esta película, con Henry Cavill, Eiza González, Rosamund Pike... Todo eso hacía un paquete muy atractivo para interpretar a Manny Salazar. ¿Qué tiene Guy Ritchie como director que hace que un actor acepte que el guion pueda cambiar prácticamente delante de sus ojos? La película me llegó como una oferta directa a través de mis agentes. Tenía el guion dos meses y medio antes y, como la rodamos en inglés, me puse a trabajarlo mucho. Cuando llegué a los fittings, empecé a cruzarme con gente del equipo que me decía que Guy lo cambiaba todo. Me empecé a preocupar cuando me dijeron que Guy Ritchie lo cambiaba todo. Y efectivamente, Con Guy Ritchie, yo no rodé nunca una frase que estuviera en el guion que había estudiado durante dos meses y medio. Él viaja con guionistas, es coguionista y va cambiando las cosas en función de lo que ha rodado. Esta flexibilidad se la permite trabajar desde sus primeras películas con un grupo muy reducido de personas, su "gang", que se entiende con mirarse. Yo como actor lo viví con mucho susto inicialmente, porque me daban, con suerte, las escenas la noche anterior, muchas veces en el tráiler de maquillaje. Yo le decía: 'Oiga Mr. Ritchie, yo me manejo con el inglés pero entenderá usted que estos cambios... Y me decía: 'No te preocupes que lo estás haciendo muy bien'. Pero vi que la cosa funcionaba y que todos los cambios que hacía mejoraban lo que había sobre papel. Una vez que entendí el juego, descubrí que lo que Guy exige a los actores es estar muy presentes, abiertos, flexibles y conectados con lo que están haciendo. Y acabó siendo uno de los rodajes más divertidos en los que he estado nunca. ¿Qué descubriste de ti como actor trabajando con Guy Ritchie que no esperabas descubrir? Yo ya con la edad que tengo, pues ya yo me tengo más o menos identificado, pero sí me alegró ver que era capaz de de asumir y abrazar ese reto. De rodar en un idioma que no es el mío, en una película en la que la gente habla mucho, hay unas unas parrafadas llenas de ironía, de doble sentidos... Todos nos pisábamos, eran réplicas constantes y me agradó ver que era capaz de hacerlo, que el resultado estaba bien y que el director no me despedía, me decía: 'Vuelva usted al día siguiente'. La película se rodó en 2023 y llega ahora a España, después de varios retrasos y cambios en su distribución. ¿En algún momento pensaste que se había quedado en un cajón? Yo contaba con que saldría porque es una película de Guy Ritchie y tiene estrellas muy conocidas de Hollywood. Pero sí, es una película que estuvo un tiempo metida en un cajón por problemas. Los detalles se me escapan, entre la productora, las distribuidoras y demás. En octubre publicas 'Triángulo', una novela sobre deseo, masculinidad y una fosa común de la Guerra Civil. ¿Qué querías explorar esta vez como escritor? Yo escribo para mí, para comprender cosas. Siempre cito a Borges, que decía que escribir es una manera de leer más profundamente. La novela empieza explorando la relación entre la masculinidad y las nuevas feminidades, pero, como ocurre en las buenas películas y los buenos libros, aparecen otros temas. En este caso, la memoria histórica y, fundamentalmente, la violencia crónica contra las mujeres. También es una llamada de atención contra la tibieza. En la 'Divina Comedia', Dante sitúa antes de la entrada al infierno a los tibios, los que no toman partido y se ponen de perfil pensando que a ellos nunca les va a pasar nada. Vivimos unos tiempos en los que creo que no hay que ponerse de perfil y en los que las torres de marfil no van a funcionar. Hace unos meses dijiste que la violencia verbal puede ser la antesala de la violencia física. Ahora tenemos los ejemplos de lo ocurrido en Oviedo, lo que está ocurriendo en Ceuta... ¿Qué estamos haciendo mal como sociedad? Es un tema muy complejo, pero hay una cosa que está clara: la violencia verbal siempre precede o es la antesala de la violencia física. Siempre se empieza por el insulto, por denigrar, por deshumanizar. Creo que vivimos un momento muy complejo y que la diferencia ahora es que quienes odian, gritan y deshumanizan tienen un altavoz muy potente y llegan a mucha gente. Creo que quienes no somos machistas, racistas, homófobos o fascistas tenemos que enfrentarnos a esos discursos de odio con contundencia, denunciarlos y demostrarles que somos más. Creo que esa es la única esperanza que tenemos como sociedad. Siempre has sido muy activo en causas sociales, desde la defensa del pueblo saharaui, pasando por Palestina y hasta cuestiones medioambientales. ¿Qué hace que una causa te lleve a implicarte públicamente y a asumir el coste de posicionarte? Creo que la implicación con las causas siempre tiene que ver con la negación de derechos humanos elementales. Yo apoyaré a colectivos y personas que estén siendo oprimidos y a quienes se nieguen derechos básicos, dignidad, igualdad, representación política o voz. Cuando tienes un altavoz, creo que no solo tienes el derecho, sino también la obligación de utilizarlo para denunciar lo que consideras injusto. ¿Te sorprende que posicionarse a favor de derechos humanos se perciba como izquierda cuando debería estar por encima de ideología? Creo que el auge de la extrema derecha y de los fascismos se basa en romper consensos básicos, como la igualdad entre hombres y mujeres. El feminismo no consiste en poner a las mujeres por encima de los hombres, sino en garantizar la igualdad. Eso debería ser un derecho básico, independientemente del sexo. También estamos viendo la criminalización de la inmigración. Incluso hay personas de izquierda que empiezan a justificar la inmigración porque los inmigrantes hacen determinados trabajos o porque son necesarios para las pensiones. Eso puede ser cierto, pero no debería ser la causa para dar un trato humanitario a una persona. Hay que hacerlo porque es un ser humano. Has dicho que te preocuparía más callarte por miedo que pagar un peaje por opinar. ¿Has pagado alguna vez ese peaje? Supongo que sí, o sé que sí, pero no me lo voy a beber. Yo no vengo aquí a cantar tangos ni a victimizarme. Cada uno tenemos una relación con nuestro estar en el mundo. Yo necesito sentir que, de alguna manera, contribuyo a lo que creo que es justo y hago lo que puedo. Muy futbolero y socio del Atlético. ¿Sigues viendo fútbol con la misma pasión? ¿Qué significa para ti el Atleti? El Atleti para mí significa lo que ha significado siempre: rebeldía. Soy de Madrid y, cuando era pequeño, iba al colegio y todos los niños eran del Madrid, salvo uno o dos que éramos del Atleti. Me crié con la sensación de que para ser del Madrid valía casi todo el mundo y que para ser del Atleti había que tener una manera muy especial. Has sido muy crítico con la transformación del fútbol en un negocio. ¿Cómo ves ese proceso? Odio eterno al fútbol moderno. Yo no soy un ingenuo. Entiendo que el fútbol siempre ha sido un negocio y que es un espectáculo, pero El fútbol cada vez tiene menos de competición y más de espectáculo guionizado. Creo que la monetización de todo está apartando a las aficiones. Los precios de las entradas y de las camisetas son una muestra. Tiene que ver también con la gentrificación: nuestras ciudades, los campos de fútbol y las competiciones se están convirtiendo en parques temáticos para turistas con dinero. Creo que se está perdiendo algo muy importante del fútbol, que es la pertenencia y la relación con un equipo y una afición. Has defendido que los futbolistas deberían posicionarse socialmente por el altavoz que tienen. Ahora tenemos el ejemplo de Borja Iglesias... ¿Los ves más implicados que antes? Y mira la que le ha caído... No se implican. Estadísticamente es imposible que no haya futbolistas gays y ninguno sale a decirlo. Mueven tal cantidad de dinero que entiendo que el negocio prima y que hay temas que pueden resultar incómodos para los patrocinadores. Cuando hay un colectivo en el que es imposible estadísticamente que no haya cierto tipo de personas y esas personas nunca se las ve, no tienen voz o están condenadas a callarse, creo que eso es significativo. Acabo de hacer una película en Argentina que habla de esto, 'No lo grites'. Interpreto a un agente de futbolistas y la película va de unos agentes que descubren a un niño que puede ser el próximo Maradona o Messi, pero el niño es gay. La duda es qué hacer con él: cumplir su sueño, pero pudiendo destrozarle la vida si tiene que ocultar quién es. Le preguntamos a la IA qué pregunta te haría si solo pudiera hacerte una y nos dijo esto: ¿En qué momento la ficción deja de ser un entretenimiento y se convierte en la herramienta más eficaz para despertar la conciencia política de un país? Buena pregunta de la inteligencia artificial que no es inteligencia ni es artificial, pero eso es otro debate. Los seres humanos necesitamos relatos para vivir. Construimos una memoria personal que nos permite tener un pasado y proyectarnos hacia un futuro, y las sociedades hacen lo mismo. Creo que la ficción es una manera de crear esa conversación: quiénes somos, de dónde venimos y hacia dónde vamos, y de llamar a la reflexión y a la emoción. Cuando actúo soy una pieza al servicio de una narrativa ajena, mientras que cuando escribo soy el dueño de esa narrativa. Yo siempre digo que yo no escribo para dar respuestas. No creo que esa sea la misión de la cultura. La cultura tiene que sembrar preguntas, sembrar dudas, cuestionar y luego que cada uno saque sus respuestas. Después de la película y la novela, ¿qué viene? Voy a estrenar una comedia de terror de Kiko Prada, 'Tránsito', en el Festival Isla Calavera de Tenerife en otoño. También está mi participación en la serie 'Atasco' y en 'Chiquito El Grande', una serie sobre Chiquito de la Calzada. Además, estoy escribiendo una novela nueva. Siempre estoy escribiendo.

articles.title: 'American Idol' ditches Hollywood for Georgia after two decades as California loses another production
articles.summary: "American Idol" is relocating from Hollywood to an Atlanta-area studio complex as Georgia's tax incentives and infrastructure lure major productions.
articles.body: "American Idol" is ditching Hollywood for Georgia amid renewed concerns about California’s competitiveness. On Wednesday, Fremantle, the production company behind ABC's long-running singing competition, confirmed the relocation to Fox News Digital. The company is reportedly in final discussions with an Atlanta-area studio complex, according to Deadline. Longtime fans and viewers of the show were quick to react on social media. "'You’re going to…Atlanta!' Just doesn’t have that same ring to it," one user wrote on X. "Another one bites the dust LA. Sad!" another added. "So much for those 'hollyweird' tax breaks eh?" one person quipped. NEWSOM SAYS FILM TAX INCENTIVES ARE BRINGING HOLLYWOOD HOME BUT INDUSTRY EXPERTS WARN IT MAY BE 'TOO LATE' "LOL !!! Another production Hollywood GETTING THE HELL OUT OF CALIFORNIA ! AFTER 25 YEARS BYEEEEE GAVIN NEWSOM American Idol is OUT OF CALI," another wrote. While the move marks a significant change for a series long associated with Hollywood, Lisa Cusack, president of the Don’t L.A. My Burbank PAC, said the relocation should be a warning to California officials. "The issue is that Georgia offers generous incentives for reality TV shows, while California often leaves them behind," Cusack told Fox News Digital. "For example, Nick Schultz’s entertainment tax credit bill, AB 2319, specifically excludes unscripted programming." "Now Georgia has a lot of the same infrastructure as Hollywood, and offers a less expensive, more family-friendly quality of life," she continued. "There’s very little keeping even Hollywood business in California anymore. This should serve as a five-shot-espresso wake-up call to Rob Bonta to settle with Paramount and not make things worse." Last month, Paramount CEO David Ellison threatened to relocate the company’s headquarters to a more business-friendly state such as Georgia, Tennessee or Texas if California Attorney General Rob Bonta, who is leading 11 other states in an effort to block Paramount's $111 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), did not negotiate a settlement by Oct. 1. PARAMOUNT-WARNER BROS DISCOVERY ANTITRUST TRIAL DATE SET; MERGER PUT ON PAUSE OVER LEGAL BATTLE GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE Puck News first reported Ellison's potential exit plans. As Puck News reported, Ellison could move Paramount — and potentially Warner Bros. Discovery if he ultimately merges the companies — out of California "regardless of the eventual outcome of the case." Ellison has even developed a five-year plan that would relocate the vast majority of jobs out of the state while still maintaining a footprint in Hollywood. On Wednesday, TMZ reported that the Los Angeles Mayor's Office and the California Attorney General's Office were told Paramount would announce Tuesday that it was leaving California. No such announcement had been made as of Wednesday. "I tried to warn you," Spencer Pratt wrote on X following the TMZ news. "LA is getting absolutely decimated by the insane communist wackos running California. Bob Bonta’s jihad against Paramount is a death blow. What a corrupt piece of s---." According to Deadline, Georgia has become one of the country’s most competitive production hubs by offering a 20% base film and television tax credit, with a potential 10% promotional uplift for qualifying projects. The state’s official guidelines list television series among eligible productions and require at least $500,000 in qualified Georgia spending. Stephen Weizenecker, a partner at Barnes & Thornburg in Georgia, said there are three pillars to analyze when deciding whether to film in California or Georgia. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE "Physical infrastructure is equally critical. A show like 'American Idol' requires massive sound stages, specialized equipment for elaborate performance sets, live-audience capacity, and proximity to rehearsal spaces, wardrobe, and production offices," said Weizenecker, who has had a direct role in developing Georgia's entertainment tax incentive framework and spent over two decades advising productions on filming all across the world. "Georgia now offers purpose-built studio campuses — including Tyler Perry Studios, Trilith Studios and Assembly Studios — that rival Los Angeles market in scale and amenities. I have worked closely with many of these facilities as they grew from concept to world-class campuses, and I can attest to their capacity to support the most demanding productions." Weizenecker said production tax incentives often serve as the "decisive tipping point" once the infrastructure boxes are checked. CARRIE UNDERWOOD SAYS HER FAMILY COULD BE 'SELF-SUSTAINED' ON TENNESSEE FARM AWAY FROM HOLLYWOOD SPOTLIGHT "As someone instrumental in crafting the Georgia Entertainment Industry Investment Act, I have seen firsthand how Georgia's program offers structural advantages over California's that make it exceptionally attractive for a recurring, high-budget unscripted series." Additionally, Georgia has invested strategically in workforce development since the enactment of the Georgia Entertainment Industry Investment Act, according to Weizenecker. "The Georgia Film Academy, a collaboration among the University System of Georgia, the Technical College System of Georgia and the Georgia Department of Economic Development, has trained thousands of professionals across disciplines from grip and electric to visual effects. That pipeline, reinforced by the sheer volume of annual production activity, has created a self-sustaining ecosystem of IATSE-qualified crew members who live and work in the state full-time." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "Virtually every major production services vendor — equipment rental, transportation, catering, construction and specialty providers — now maintains a permanent Georgia presence," he continued. "Post-production facilities offering editorial, color grading, sound mixing and VFX have expanded significantly, with several national and international post houses establishing Atlanta-area operations." "The same infrastructure supporting Marvel, Lucasfilm, Netflix and major network television productions is available to a show of 'American Idol's' caliber," he added. "Having advised many of the productions and facilities that anchor this ecosystem, I can confirm Georgia's vendor community is fully capable of supporting this show." The show’s relocation also underscores how its talent is already less tied to Los Angeles. Carrie Underwood, who won "American Idol" in 2005 and now serves as one of the show’s judges, has lived with her family on a 400-acre farm in Franklin, Tennessee, since leaving Hollywood in 2019. Underwood has described her Tennessee home as the place where she and her husband, former NHL player Mike Fisher, raise their two sons, care for livestock and grow vegetables. In a recent interview with Fox News Digital, Underwood said farm life is the opposite of her on-camera career and that she takes pride in being a hands-on mother when she is home. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP While Underwood’s move was not attributed to the "American Idol" production decision, her established life in Tennessee highlights how the show’s stars — and now its production — are increasingly less dependent on Hollywood. Fox News Digital's CJ Womack and Joseph A. Wulfsohn contributed to this post.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI’s soundtrack will feature 34 brand-new tracks
articles.summary: Rockstar has announced the soundtrack for GTA 6, which will include new songs from Keith Richards, Travis Scott, and Yung Lean.
articles.body: After teasing a music-related reveal a few days ago, Rockstar has officially announced the soundtrack for Grand Theft Auto VI. Called Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the soundtrack will feature 34 songs, which Rockstar describes as “brand-new, original tracks.” Based on the first six singles, which are available today, it seems that the collection will span a pretty wide range of genres, with everyone from Keith Richards to Travis Scott contributing. Here’s what’s been confirmed so far: * Yung Lean - “That’s It” (feat. Future & Metro Boomin) * Travis Scott - “RHYNO” (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo) * CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy - “Sexy Magic” * Morgan Wallen - “Last Thing You Need” * Rauw Alejandro - “Macacoa 2000” * Keith Richards - “Bright Lights, Big City” The soundtrack will be coming to all major streaming services, and Rockstar says that it’ll be available on both CD and vinyl. It’ll be launching on November 19th, the same day as the game. The reveal of the album is just the latest Rockstar announcement as GTA VI approaches it’s long-awaited and oft-delayed launch. Last month the studio debuted a lengthy first-look at gameplay, which premiered on Netflix before being released on YouTube. The anticipation around the game is so big that almost every major game publisher — with the notable exception of Nintendo — has gotten out of its way.

articles.title: Spotify’s Fresh Finds Forward gives artists free studio time and more
articles.summary: Spotify is providing emerging artists with a ton of resources, including free therapy.
articles.body: Getting added to Spotify’s Fresh Finds playlists can be a huge break for artists trying to cut through the noise on streaming. Now Spotify is launching a program called Fresh Finds Forward, which aims to give artists the tools to capitalize on that exposure. Artists added to any Fresh Finds playlist after January 1st, 2026, can join the program and get 12 months of additional resources, the most extravagant of which is free studio time for US-based artists at Electric Lady Studios in NYC, The Lighthouse at Ocean Way Nashville, or Spotify Studios in LA. Beyond that, artists will get early access to Spotify tools and features, priority access to tour and music video partnerships, as well as 12 months of Landr Studio Pro and Splice’s Creator Plan. Spotify is also offering artists six months of free therapy through BetterHelp, because we all know trying to make it as a musician is stressful and potentially soul-crushing, as scoring a Fresh Finds placement doesn’t guarantee there won’t be further rejections and failures. Unlike with the so-called Discovery Mode, where artists were paid a “promotional royalty rate,” in exchange for higher algorithmic promotion, Spotify says the Fresh Finds Forward program doesn’t change royalty rates, and is provided completely free of charge to participating artists.

articles.title: Irlanda comunica que no participará en Eurovisión en apoyo a Palestina
articles.standfirst: Segunda nación, junto a Países Bajos, que confirma su ausencia para la edición de 2027
articles.summary: Segunda nación, junto a Países Bajos, que confirma su ausencia para la edición de 2027
articles.body: Eurovisión pasa por una de sus crisis más graves en los últimos años al ver como cada vez son más los países participantes que se niegan a concursar en él ni a hacerles publicidad. El último caso ha sido el de Irlanda. La cadena pública irlandesa (RTE) mantiene su boicot al concurso y ha confirmado este jueves, 17 de septiembre, en un comunicado que no participará ni emitirá el Festival de Eurovisión 2027 que se celebra en Brujas el próximo mes de mayo, La RTE ha explicado en el escrito que su posición al respecto “se mantiene sin cambios”. “RTE considera que la participación de Irlanda no se justifica dada la terrible y continua pérdida de vidas en Gaza y la crisis humanitaria que sigue poniendo en riesgo la vida de tantos civiles. Así mismo, RTE sigue profundamente preocupada por la constante negativa a conceder acceso independiente a periodistas internacionales al territorio”, señalan en el comunicado. Esta será pues la segunda vez en la que Irlanda no participe, pues ya lo hizo este año por el mismo motivo. En especial, al considerar “grave” que la Unión Europea de Radiodifusión (UER) permitiera la participación de la israelí KAN. La República de Irlanda fue uno de los cinco países, junto con Islandia, Países Bajos, España y Eslovenia, que no participaron. Hasta la fecha solo los irlandeses y Países Bajos han confirmado que volverán a ausentarse de este certamen. Mientras países como la República de Irlanda o Países Bajos han confirmado que no estarán en el Festival de Eurovisión 2027, España sigue sin saber qué hará. Radio Televisión Española confirmó el año pasado que mientras Israel continúe participando, ellos no estarán. Lo que se presupone que dará pie a una nueva ausencia de los españoles.

articles.title: Singer Duncan Sheik in ‘critical but stable’ condition and receiving care
articles.summary: Tony Award-winning singer and songwriter Duncan Sheik is in “critical but stable” condition and receiving medical care, according to a statement posted to his Instagram account Wednesday evening.
articles.body: Tony Award-winning singer and songwriter Duncan Sheik is in “critical but stable” condition and receiving medical care, according to a statement posted to his Instagram account Wednesday evening. “Duncan is currently receiving medical care and remains in critical but stable condition,” the statement said. “Out of respect for Duncan and our family, we will not be sharing further medical details at this time,” it added. “We kindly ask for privacy during this incredibly difficult time and will provide updates when appropriate,” the statement continued. “Thank you for the continued love and support.” It remains unclear where Sheik is receiving medical care or what his prognosis is. Sheik, 56, is perhaps best known for his 1996 hit “Barely Breathing,” which remains at the top of his Spotify page three decades later. The song earned him a Grammy nomination for best male pop vocal performance. He has released nine studio albums over his career, with the most recent in 2022. In 2002, Sheik began writing music for the theater. That year, he composed the music for the New York Shakespeare Festival production of “Twelfth Night.” But his biggest break came just years later, in 2006, with the success of “Spring Awakening” on Broadway, for which he co-wrote the music with Steven Sater. His work on the breakout Broadway show earned him two Tony Awards: best orchestrations and best original score, which he shared with Sater. “Spring Awakening” also won best musical at the Tonys that year and earned a Grammy Award for best musical show album. According to a 2012 Broadway World article, Sheik said he had been working on the music for a “Spring Awakening” film adaptation. It is unclear whether that project is still in the works. The show’s off-Broadway revival begins previews on Nov. 27 and officially opens on Dec. 17. Sheik kept composing for the theater after “Spring Awakening,” writing music for “Alice By Heart” (2012), “American Psycho” (2013), “The Taming of the Shrew” (2016) and “The Secret Life of Bees” (2019).
